meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 处理分子生物学序列和自动分析生物信息数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理生物信息学数据，需要自动化分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with bioinformatics data and need automated analysis pipelines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Biopython 库编写 Python 代码,完成序列处理、文件解析(FASTA/GenBank 等)、NCBI 数据库访问、BLAST、比对、系统发育等生物信息学任务。
howto.when: 当用户提出涉及序列操作、文件解析(如 FASTA/GenBank)或数据库访问(如 NCBI)等生物信息学任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 FASTA 文件,计算每条序列的 GC 含量。
用 BLAST 搜索这段 DNA 序列,给出前五个相似结果。
say.note: 会调用 NCBI BLAST 并解析结果。

say.text: 从 GenBank 下载登录号 EU490707 的序列并转成 FASTA。
say.note: 会通过 Entrez 获取记录并转换格式。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude writes Python code using the Biopython library to handle sequences, parse files (FASTA/GenBank, etc.), access NCBI databases, perform BLAST searches, sequence alignments, and phylogenetic analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests bioinformatics tasks involving sequence manipulation, file parsing (e.g., FASTA/GenBank), or database access (e.g., NCBI).

say_en.text: Read this FASTA file and calculate the GC content of each sequence.
say_en.note: Writes Biopython code to parse the file and output stats.

say_en.text: BLAST this DNA sequence and show the top five hits.
say_en.note: Calls NCBI BLAST and parses the results.

say_en.text: Fetch GenBank record EU490707 and convert it to FASTA.
say_en.note: Uses Entrez to retrieve and convert the record.
